messages:
elaine: Thanks all — following up from today's all-hands Q&A. I'll capture the short answers here so it's easy to reference. Please @reply if anything missing.
sasha: Quick recap: comp & leveling timelines won't change — annual comp review in Nov, mid-cycle calibration in May. We're formalizing manager packets to surface leveling evidence earlier.
maria: Can managers submit promotion cases outside the cadence for urgent hires / retention? If so what's the path?
elaine: Yes — ad-hoc promotions are allowed. Process: manager draft -> director sign-off -> people-ops review. We'll add a lightweight "expedited promo" form. ETA: doc by next Wed.
raj: Re: raises — will budget be distributed differently if we move to band-based pools?
sasha: No major change to total budget this year. We're shifting to band-level pools to make allocations fairer. Managers will get a per-band target number in the packet.
maria: 401(k) match question from folks — any plan to increase match or change vesting?
elaine: Short answer: no change to the match this fiscal year. We are evaluating vesting schedule changes but nothing committed. People Ops will run a benefits survey; please opt in when we send it.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: people-ops/benefits-survey opens Mon 09:00 PT — link will be posted then.
raj: For leveling rubric updates, will there be concrete examples for IC -> Senior transitions? Managers want sample writeups.
sasha: Yep, adding example writeups and a short checklist for manager calibration. We'll include 3 sample narratives per level transition.
maria: Awesome. Can we get a one-pager we can share with new hires about comp cadence and promos?
elaine: Yes — "Comp & Leveling at Redwood" one-pager will be published to the handbook and circulated to hiring managers. Expect it by next Friday.
raj: Last: how will exceptions be tracked? audit log or ticketing?
sasha: We'll track expedited cases in a shared spreadsheet + attach review notes in Workday approvals. Final audits kept by People Ops.
maria: Thanks — :thumbsup:
elaine: Thanks everyone. If you have a specific case, DM me or drop it in #people-ops and tag @sasha. Closing thread once doc live.
